newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Station Casinos cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Station Casinos cut.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Station Casinos Inc to buy from strong buy.
-- said cut the fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $0.75 a share from $0.85 a share and trimmed the fiscal 1999 estimate to $0.90 a share from $0.95 a share.
-- cited "uncertainties in Kansas City and St. Louis markets."

-- said "while we still believe Kansas City Station will show improved operating and EBITDA performance and increased market share over the next four quarters, we realize the time-frame for these improvements will be slower than anticipated."
-- said Station Casinos' long-term valuation remains attractive due to stable operating performance of the Las Vegas properties and anticipated contribution from Sunset Station.
